far.description: Far Manager - powerful file manager with plugin architecture and scripting
far.usage:
Far.exe # Launch file manager
F3 - View file, F4 - Edit, F5 - Copy, F6 - Move, F7 - Create directory
Ctrl+\ - Root directory, Alt+F1/F2 - Drive selection
F9 - Main menu, F12 - Screens
